linkedin.headline: #1 NYT Best Selling Author of The Let Them Theory | Host of Award-Winning The Mel Robbins Podcast | CEO, 143 Studios | Co-Founder, Pure Genius Protein
linkedin.summary:
Mel Robbins is the creator and host of the award-winning The Mel Robbins Podcast, one of the most successful podcasts in the world, and a #1 New York Times bestselling author of The Let Them Theory. She's also the founder and CEO of the media production company 143 Studios. She has amassed 40 million followers online and is one of the most respected experts in mindset, life improvement, and behavior change. The Wall Street Journal calls her a “billion-view podcaster” and TIME Magazine says she gives millions of listeners around the globe “a reason to believe in themselves.”

Her books have been translated into 63 languages and include the #1 New York Times, #1 Amazon, #1 Audible, and #1 Sunday Times bestselling The Let Them Theory, which is the top selling book of 2025 according to Publisher’s Weekly, with 7 million copies sold within nine months of its release date. It is on pace to have the best non-fiction book launch of all time. She is also the author of the multimillion-copy-selling The 5 Second Rule, The High 5 Habit, and seven #1 audiobook releases on Audible.

USA Today calls Mel “a force to be reckoned with.” She is a global phenomenon in the publishing industry and podcasting. Her Boston-based media production company, 143 Studios, produces award-winning content, podcasts, events, audio series, online courses, journals, and books, along with professional development education forpartners likeStarbucks, Ulta Beauty, JP Morgan Chase, LinkedIn, Headspace, and Audible.

The Mel Robbins Podcast has won some of the most prestigious awards given to podcasts, including Webby, Signal Awards, and iHeart. It was also recognized as one of Apple Podcasts' Top Shared and Followed Shows of 2024 and 2023 and Spotify Top Global Shows of 2024. Notable accolades for Robbins include being named to Time 100 Most Influential Digital Voices of 2025, a Forbes 50 Over 50 Honoree, USA Today Top 5 Mindset & Performance Coaches in the World, and one of the fifty most influential influencers on The Hollywood Reporter’s Creator A-List in 2024.

Thanks for being here!

Learn more at melrobbins.com.

Brand partnership inquiries: MelRobbinsTeam@unitedtalent.com

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Pure Genius Protein is unlike any other protein you’ve ever had. It’s a protein shot containing 23 grams of complete protein in a TSA-friendly 3.38 oz bottle designed for busy schedules, travel, long shifts, low appetite days, and everything in between. It tastes like juice and it’s not chalky or bloating. It’s only 100 calories, zero sugar, zero fat, shelf-stable, lactose- and gluten-free, with no artificial flavors or sweeteners.

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description: 143 means “I Love You” (one letter to say “I,” four letters to say “love,” and three letters to say “you.”) And it’s true! I’m loving my work: We’re on a mission to create quality content, inspiring experiences and essential tools to help you be the leader in your own life. 143 is my personal sign from the Universe - Mr. Rogers used it as his sign too, so know I’m in good company. And I'm also in good company working with our collaborative, courageous and creative team at 143 Studios.

positions.title: Legal Analyst - On-Air Commentator
positions.description:
Before I reinvented my own career, I was one of CNN's most popular on-air commentators and opinion writers. I analyzed stories that intersected legal, ethical and human behavior issues. My provocative opinion pieces were read by millions of people on CNN.com. I covered cases that deeply impacted me, especially the murders of Trayvon Martin, Michael Brown, Tamir Rice, and Eric Garner.

I stand behind and fight for social justice. This job, along with my time as a criminal defense attorney at Legal Aid in New York City, fueled my desire to help people get the fair treatment they deserve.

latestPosts.caption:
I can’t believe I’m sitting down with someone I’ve looked up to for more than four decades: THE Oprah Winfrey.

I first started watching @oprah on local television as a little girl in Michigan. Through every chapter of my life, I have returned to Oprah’s work for inspiration, encouragement, and direction.

This is more than an interview for me. It is deeply personal. Now you get to hear the questions I’ve wanted to ask Oprah for years.

Comment “Oprah” and I’ll send you a link to the episode.

🎧 “Oprah Winfrey: How to Find Your Unique Purpose, Authentic Power, and Calling In Life”

When @gabormatemd told me this, it stopped me in my tracks…

Siblings may grow up in the same house, but that doesn’t mean their childhoods were the same. Not even close.

Same parents? Nope.
Same family? Nope.
Same childhood? Absolutely not.

Parents show up differently for each child depending on the season of their life, their relationship, and even their financial situation. 

It’s not about who is loved more.
It’s about how that love is expressed — and how each child experiences it.

If you’ve ever wondered why you and your siblings remember childhood so differently — this is why.
This clip is from my conversation with Dr. Gabor Maté on @themelrobbinspodcast 🎧 “Why You Feel Lost in Life: Dr. Gabor Maté on Trauma & How to Heal.”

You can learn more about this and so much more in his incredible book The Myth of Normal.
Send this to someone who needs this reminder ❤️

Send this quote to your daughter to remind her to apologize less, take up more space and dream louder than you did at her age. ❤️

My daughters are in their 20s and I hope they stop questioning their intuition every time it tells them something important.

I hope they walk away from jobs and relationships sooner, because the longer you stay in something that’s not meant for you, the more you end up hurting yourself. 

I hope they ask for help, instead of suffering in silence like I so often did. 

Every lesson I learned through heartbreak, disappointment and self-doubt is a lesson I know that each and everyone of us must learn… 

But if I could wave a magic wand 🪄 I would wish for my daughters to learn these life lessons in years (not the decades it took me) because learning how to trust and love yourself that’s one of the greatest gifts anyone could receive. 

❤️

These are my favorite life lessons from my conversation with @Oprah that will stay with me forever.

Which one did you need to hear today? ❤️
